scenes.text: Regular polygons have every side equal and every interior angle equal; otherwise they are irregular.
Name a 4-sided polygon. The answer is quadrilateral. A polygon with 4 sides has this name.
A regular polygon for a school fundraiser has 6 equal sides and angles. What is the name of its shape? Pause the video and think.
A regular polygon for a school fundraiser has 6 equal sides and angles. What is the name of its shape? The answer is hexagon. A polygon with 6 sides has this name.
